tool.name: Export AnnData
tool.description: Export an AnnData dataset to tabular files
tool.help:
This tool exports an AnnData dataset to tabular files using the `write_csvs` method. The output includes CSV files containing the data matrix, gene annotations, and cell barcodes.
### AnnData AnnData is a Python package for handling annotated data matrices, particularly useful for single-cell omics data. It stores the main data matrix along with annotations for observations (cells) and variables (genes).
### Output The tool generates a directory containing: - `matrix.csv`: The main data matrix - `genes.csv`: Gene annotations - `barcodes.csv`: Cell barcodes/identifiers
For more details, see the [AnnData documentation](https://anndata.readthedocs.io).
